newsitem.title: USA: Natl Diagnostics says cash needed to expand.
newsitem.headline: Natl Diagnostics says cash needed to expand.

text.p: National Diagnostics Inc said on Friday its president and chief operating officer, Curtis Alliston, indicated the company would need additional capital in order to expand further.
As part of its expansion plan, the company said in a statement it had opened its fourth fixed outpatient diagnostic center in the Jacksonville, Fla., area.
But Alliston indicated that future expansion of new sites would require additional capital, National Diagnostics said.
The company was not immediately available to comment on capital requirements.
National Diagnostic also said its strong revenue growth was derived from planned expansion of its mobile and fixed site centers.
It started expanding after its 1994 initial public offering, using its $3.7 million in revenues. In fiscal 1995, the company said it had revenues exceeding $6.2 million.
